description: Changes the account's food preferences: diet, foods to avoid and dislikes, in plain words. Omitted fields keep their current value; a supplied list replaces that list whole, so a change to one item is sent as the full updated list (get_food_preferences gives the current one). Returns the saved preferences. They apply to the next planning, search or recipe call on every surface: recipes that use these foods are left out. Chop it leaves out the foods a person chooses but is not built for managing allergies, and never describes a recipe, plan or list as safe for one. Idempotent. Requires a linked Chop it account.

diet.description: The whole-week diet. Omit to keep the current one.

dislikes.description: The complete list of other foods the household doesn't eat, in plain words ('mushrooms', 'coriander'). Omit to keep the current list; pass [] to clear it.

foodsToAvoid.description: The complete list of the fourteen common foods to leave out; recipes using them are left out. Omit to keep the current list; pass [] to clear it.

name: update_food_preferences
title: Change food preferences
